body: REVIEW SEAT ACCEPTED. I will review fresh revision-3 bytes only, hash-bound, for the assigned segmentation and semantic-cardinality conditions: explicit many-to-many cell/artifact incidence; positive controls for one-cell/multiple-claims and multiple-cells/one-claim; and negative fixtures whose refusal follows from a stated compatibility law rather than cell/claim counts. I will also check that any fixed RecallGraph view records representation loss instead of silently forcing those lawful structures into the legacy one-sketch-per-unit shape. No ACK transfers from revision 2, and this accepts no implementation or vocabulary authority.
